status: TEMPLATE - nothing measured yet. Filled on site 2026-10-08 by the owner and Emilya; the survey list and its order are in docs/moxir/MODEL_VS_REAL_2026-10-07.md section 4.
layer: Layered AFTER moxir-hall-dims-2026-09-28.json, moxir-hall-features-2026-09-28.json, moxir-hall-crane-dj-2026-09-28.json, moxir-hall-dims-2026-10-02.json (the 10-02 chain; with PR #772 the 10-02 file also carries the 09-29 crane). Put it LAST. A null top-level key is skipped by hall.py (resolve_dims: `given[key] is None: continue`), so this file changes nothing until a value is written.
how_to_fill: 1) Write each reading into measurements.<key>: value, method (what was done, e.g. 'laser up from floor, 3 readings, mean'), by, at (local time), photo (file name of the photo of the meter display AND the target), readings (every raw number). 2) Copy the value to the top-level key of the same name ONLY for keys hall.py reads (the reads_it field says which). 3) Keep source 'measured' only for values taken with a tape or a laser on site; a photo estimate goes in an earlier layer, not here. 4) Commit the photos' file names, not the photos (they are the owner's, private).
frame: hall.json frame, metres: y up from the floor at the point measured; z along the hall, 0 = the midpoint of the paired columns at the expansion joint, + toward the entry; x across, 0 = midway between the two nave rows' inner faces, + = house right (the right hand of someone on the dance floor facing the press).
source_note: hall.py tags a key 'measured' only when this file's source is tape / measured / laser; null keys are skipped, so this tag applies only to values actually written.

crane_bridge_bottom_h_m.what: NEAR crane (the one to park over the DJ): floor to the underside of the bridge girders, at mid-span (x 0) AND under each pick (x -5.0 and +5.6); 3 readings each
crane_bridge_bottom_h_m.where: on the floor under the bridge, meter flat on the floor, beam straight up (use the meter's tilt read-out: 90 +-0.5 deg)
crane_bridge_bottom_h_m.tolerance: +-0.05 m (the cut moves 1:1 with it; margin to the 0.5 m raised-hands rule is 0.24 m at 7.95)
crane_bridge_bottom_h_m.reads_it: hall.py (KEYS_FROM_DIMS): copy the value to the top-level key of the same name

crane_girder_inner_gap_m.what: NEAR crane: clear gap between the two bridge girders' bottom flanges (inner edge to inner edge), and each girder's bottom-flange width
crane_girder_inner_gap_m.where: from the bridge walkway, or from the floor with the meter's horizontal mode on a photo with a tape held across
crane_girder_inner_gap_m.tool: tape (on the bridge) or laser + photo with a 1 m reference
crane_girder_inner_gap_m.tolerance: +-0.05 m (trim moves 0.29 m per 1 m of gap)
crane_girder_inner_gap_m.reads_it: NOTHING READS IT YET - code owed (hall.py hard-codes it); recorded here so the change has its number (hall.py:681 girders_dz_m +-1.1, girder_w_m 0.7)

crane_girder_bottom_flange.what: bottom flange type (box girder / I or plate girder), flange width and thickness (mm) where a beam clamp would bite
crane_girder_bottom_flange.where: close photo from the bridge walkway with a tape across the flange
crane_girder_bottom_flange.reads_it: NOTHING READS IT YET - code owed (hall.py hard-codes it); recorded here so the change has its number

crane_rated_load_t.what: the rated-load plate on the near crane's bridge (and the far crane's), maker, year, serial
crane_rated_load_t.where: photo of the plate (usually on the bridge side or in the cab)
crane_rated_load_t.reads_it: NOTHING READS IT YET - code owed (hall.py hard-codes it); recorded here so the change has its number (needed for the rigging sign-off)

press_face_z_m.what: the press's front face (toward the entry) along the hall, from the expansion-joint column pair (z 0)
press_face_z_m.where: tape along the floor from the joint's column face, at the press's left and right feet
press_face_z_m.tolerance: +-0.1 m (sets the DJ's z, and the crane must be within 1 m of it)
press_face_z_m.reads_it: scripts/place/rigs/moxir-2026-10-17.json stage.estimated.press_face_z_m and the press massing z_m[1]; not a hall.py key

cranes_from_door_m.what: both cranes' bridge centre lines along the hall, AS FOUND on 10-08, from the ENTRY grid line (the column row nearest the entry door, z 54 in the model - NOT the door wall)
cranes_from_door_m.where: drop a plumb (or the meter's vertical) from the bridge centre to the floor, tape from the entry grid line's column face
cranes_from_door_m.tool: laser distance meter along the floor
cranes_from_door_m.reads_it: hall.py (KEYS_FROM_DIMS): copy the value to the top-level key of the same name (entry crane, far crane)

crane_travel_z_m.what: how far each crane can run: the end stops / buffers at both runway ends (distance from the nearest grid line), any stop or rail break at the expansion joint, and whether the crane is powered (conductor rail / festoon), brakes, who can drive it
crane_travel_z_m.where: walk both runways' ends; photo each end stop; ask the site owner
crane_travel_z_m.reads_it: NOTHING READS IT YET - code owed (hall.py hard-codes it); recorded here so the change has its number

crane_rail_h_m.what: floor to the top of the crane rail on the runway beam, both rows, at grid line z 6
crane_rail_h_m.where: meter on the floor beside the column, beam up to the rail's underside edge seen from below + the rail head from the bridge walkway with a tape
crane_rail_h_m.reads_it: hall.py (KEYS_FROM_DIMS): copy the value to the top-level key of the same name

crane_bridge_depth_m.what: NEAR crane: depth of the bridge girder side plate at mid-span (top to bottom)
crane_bridge_depth_m.where: from the bridge walkway with a tape, or floor-to-top minus floor-to-underside
crane_bridge_depth_m.reads_it: hall.py (KEYS_FROM_DIMS): copy the value to the top-level key of the same name

crane_cab_h_m.what: NEAR crane cab: floor to cab bottom, cab height, and its x extent (inner edge from the nave axis)
crane_cab_h_m.where: under the cab, meter up; across from the axis with the meter flat
crane_cab_h_m.reads_it: hall.py (KEYS_FROM_DIMS): copy the value to the top-level key of the same name (height); x extent: NOTHING READS IT YET - code owed (hall.py hard-codes it); recorded here so the change has its number (hall.py:671 cab_x = xb - 3.0)

crane_trolley_x_m.what: NEAR crane trolley: where it sits along the bridge (x of its centre), and how low its hook block hangs (floor to hook bottom)
crane_trolley_x_m.where: under the trolley, meter up to the hook; tape from the axis
crane_trolley_x_m.reads_it: hall.py (KEYS_FROM_DIMS): copy the value to the top-level key of the same name (trolley x); hook height: NOTHING READS IT YET - code owed (hall.py hard-codes it); recorded here so the change has its number

column_inner_face_x_m.what: both nave rows at grid line z 6 (the tie-off columns): inner face to inner face (span between faces), column width and depth at 1 m and at 5.5 m; what is fixed to the column at 3.5 m and 5.5 m (pipes, brackets, cabinets)
column_inner_face_x_m.where: meter flat across the hall face to face; tape around the column
column_inner_face_x_m.reads_it: hall.py derives it from span_m and column_d_m; copy span_m/column_w_m/column_d_m to the top level

pitch_m.what: grid line spacing: joint pair to z 6, z 6 to z 12 (centre to centre); and the gap between the paired columns at the joint
pitch_m.where: tape along the row between column faces + half widths
pitch_m.reads_it: hall.py (KEYS_FROM_DIMS): copy the value to the top-level key of the same name

pipe_rack_z_m.what: right-row pipe rack: where the pipes start and end along the hall (z), their heights (bottom, top) and distance from the column face
pipe_rack_z_m.where: under the rack, meter up; along the row with the meter
pipe_rack_z_m.tolerance: +-0.2 m (the house-right tie-off runs at 3.2-3.6 m on grid line z 6)

machine_line_z_m.what: the machine line right of the press: where it ends toward the entry (z), its top height, and the overhead pipe's height
machine_line_z_m.where: tape along the floor; meter up to the pipe
machine_line_z_m.reads_it: dims massing machine-line / machine-pipe z_m, y_m

press_size_m.what: press: width across (x left and right edge from the nave axis), height to the crown top and to the flywheel top
press_size_m.where: meter across from the axis; meter up from the floor beside it to a target held on the crown (or photo with a 2 m tape against it)
press_size_m.reads_it: dims massing press / press-crown x_m, y_m

press_pedestal_and_cabinets.what: press control pedestal and the two press-side cabinets: footprints (x, z) and height; bolted or loose
press_pedestal_and_cabinets.where: tape from the press face and the axis; try to rock them

floor_level_dj_m.what: floor level and flatness under the DJ riser footprint (x -1.5..1.5, z 4.2..6.2) and under the barrier line (z 7.5); any rail, pit or plate there
floor_level_dj_m.where: meter on the floor, read the tilt; tape across rails

power_points.what: every live power point near the stage: board location (x, z), type (3-phase 400 V / 230 V), breaker rating (A), socket type; whether the transformer is live; the crane's own supply
power_points.where: walk the left row and the press area with the site electrician; photo each board's label
power_points.reads_it: NOTHING READS IT YET - code owed (hall.py hard-codes it); recorded here so the change has its number (no power point is in any file; audit A-05)

truss_bottom_h_m.what: floor to the space frame's bottom chord at a node over the dance floor (z ~12 and ~30)
truss_bottom_h_m.where: meter on the floor, beam up to a node plate
truss_bottom_h_m.reads_it: hall.py (KEYS_FROM_DIMS): copy the value to the top-level key of the same name

lantern_glazed.what: is the nave lantern (z 7.25-45.75) glazed, open or sheeted? are its panes intact?
lantern_glazed.where: photo straight up from z 20 at x 0
lantern_glazed.reads_it: NOTHING READS IT YET - code owed (hall.py hard-codes it); recorded here so the change has its number (laser safety, audit A-03)

door_w_m.what: entry door (the +z end): clear width and height, sill, and the entry platform's size and height
door_w_m.reads_it: hall.py (KEYS_FROM_DIMS): copy the value to the top-level key of the same name (door_w_m, door_h_m; entry_platform is a flag only)

far_gate_w_m.what: far gate (the -z end): clear width and height
far_gate_w_m.reads_it: hall.py (KEYS_FROM_DIMS): copy the value to the top-level key of the same name (far_gate_w_m, far_gate_h_m)

loose_items_cleared.what: are the five pressure vessels (x -6..0, z -2..+8), the roller conveyor (x -5..-6, z 3..14?) and the gas cylinders gone, and when
loose_items_cleared.where: photo from the DJ position toward the entry and toward the left row
loose_items_cleared.reads_it: note only (they are not in the model on purpose)

tieoff_anchor_columns.what: the two tie-off columns at grid line z 6: is the left one clear at 5.5 m and the right one clear at 3.2-3.6 m (pipes, cabinets, the cab ladder)? can a 2 t strap go round the column there?
tieoff_anchor_columns.where: photo each column face from the nave at the anchor height, with a tape held up
tieoff_anchor_columns.tolerance: yes / no + what is in the way
